# 08 Subscription Cancellation Policy

## 7.1 Subscription refunds

Subscription orders may receive a full refund within 7 days of purchase, provided the subscription is unused. Used subscriptions and requests after 7 days are non-refundable; support can arrange cancellation at the end of the billing period. Gold extensions apply only to physical products.

# 06 Escalation Guide

## 5.1 Manual review

Refunds above 1500 USD require specialist review even if otherwise eligible. A high risk customer or suspected fraud requires escalation and prohibits an automated refund recommendation. Human approval creates an internal support action only; this demo has no payment gateway.

# 10 Fraud Review Policy

## 8.1 Risk holds

High risk customers are placed on a fraud hold. Do not approve refunds or replacements while a hold is active. Escalate to a fraud specialist regardless of purchase value, customer tier, or return window. Medium risk is recorded but is not an automatic denial.

# 01 Refund Policy

## 3.2 Refund eligibility

Refund requests for physical products qualify within 30 days of delivery. Unopened items receive a full refund. Opened non-defective items incur a 15 percent restocking fee. Verified defective items receive a full refund within the return window. Digital downloads are non-refundable. Orders not delivered require shipping review, not an immediate refund.

## 3.1 Condition verification

A physical return must reference a delivered order and recorded product condition. Accepted conditions are unopened, opened, defective, and misuse. Misuse or accidental damage is not eligible for refund or warranty. Return shipping arrangements require a reviewed support action.

# 05 Customer Support Handbook

## 1.1 Evidence and case handling

For an order-specific decision retrieve the order and its linked customer. Ticket requests require the ticket, its order and its customer. Never infer an order from a name. If an order or customer cannot be verified, return insufficient evidence. Log every recommendation, tool call and human review.

## 2.2 Gold return extension

Gold tier customers have a 45 day return window for physical products, measured from delivery. Standard and Silver customers have 30 days. Gold status does not override fraud holds, digital download exclusions, or privacy requirements. Non-defective opened goods still incur the restocking fee.

# 03 Product Warranty Policy

## 4.1 Hardware defects

Defective physical products outside the applicable return window and within 365 days of delivery qualify for warranty replacement, not a cash refund. Damage caused by misuse is excluded. Defects within the return window follow the refund policy.
